body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; revise this entry when one is fixed. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 74 (2026-10-19 15:30Z) compacts rev 73.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL output. Review results are parent-only (w-fb35d7e76d72): the parent copies the complete findings verbatim to MAIN target/tmp/*-review-findings.md and sends the path.
!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task, Monitor or subagent (TermAl restricts the session's test credit). Keep store checks short (no `engram doctor` on a live store).
!! CLAUDE REVIEWERS: default model Opus (Greg fixed his limit on 10-19 at 15:28Z, Advisor #1815/#1816). The limit is per model; Sonnet is still the Claude vendor, and a Codex + Sonnet pair is VALID and not repeated. Use Sonnet, then Kimi, only if a fresh Opus attempt is refused; record the refusal text on the round. Kimi never stands in for both reviewers.

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full). Results persist in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (w-8f7e2d914724). Detached runs survive a TermAl restart.
- CLAUDE lanes: ONE call `pushd "DIR" && <test>` is credited; piping or chaining is not (w-1d9259ed138e). A compound line with an env prefix is refused credit (w-7b952e51f788).
- TARGET DIR (w-32d02e1dd7f6): a --target-dir OUTSIDE the named root is refused credit. For a WARM that's acceptable (the batch gate is the evidence): reuse a lane's own cache for speed. Gates use the default ./target inside the root.
- Credit binds to the turn's focused claim and the root's named binding (w-fec83085cff0). Never rerun only for credit.
- Nothing wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac): the coordinator re-sends after a durableButNotWoken.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends in its starting turn (w-67d248c998ef).
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep a worktree folder locked (w-eaee4f7c441c): leave it, no force.
- ANY command by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root refuses that gate's credit (w-4a8d9a7a7d08). Export patches before the launch or after the END.
- Claude lanes don't read the mailbox mid-turn: a HOLD can't stop a multi-step series already in a turn. Tell lanes to check the mailbox between steps; never START a series when a gate GO may cross.

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at MAIN; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root {work, path} takes effect next turn. Clear: {work} with no path, from a live claim. 64-slot shared table: own-clear after done.
- NAMING / EVALUATION 409s (w-33f4cde5413c, P1): a naming 409 "superseded authority image" can be retried once. An evaluation submit 409 "no longer names source root generation N under that claim" happens when an owner evaluates on its OWN pre-landing root after the item landed from Merger's batch worktree. Recovery (BarA1-confirmed): name the LANDED batch root under the owner's claim, then ONE fresh evaluator, then done --landed, then own-clear. Same-generation re-naming does not help. Release writer latency under gate load: w-1fcaa9b93d12. A 409 "canonical run and binding remain open" is correct for open items.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason).

FREEZE AND INPUT HYGIENE (w-13b44cf369af): run the freeze script and its --check with the WORKTREE as cwd; it fingerprints the cwd's repo. Merger twice froze MAIN by mistake. The input must be fully STAGED by explicit `git add` (never -A): `git diff` and the untracked listing empty before the freeze. The coordinator reads every manifest (root, head, untracked) before spawning reviewers.

GATES: from the named root, FOREGROUND: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135 --item <ref>`. START to Fable2 before LAUNCH NOW; gate and pair in parallel; a failed gate discards that round's reviews. A gate GO needs every warm series' mailed END first. Check disk before gates (alert under 100 GB; remove landed worktrees' target/ caches by literal path).

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): after termal_evaluate_acceptance, make no tracker write that turn. A settled evaluator may not be reusable (w-049ac52c3f72): spawn ONE fresh one. Pre-push evaluation gates the deliverable criteria; a landing criterion is evaluated fresh after the install. Record the pre-commit readiness of all 6 stores on the item when it runs.

APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. queuePaused for under a minute between turns is normal. A stuck head (w-7635e5349aab): ask Fable2. A model-capacity failure leaves status=error with queuePaused: ask Fable2 to resume.

MAILBOX: idempotency keys are unique per SENDER across all recipients (w-b7b80d980e7a): use recipient-qualified keys. Don't call list_mailboxes from the watchdog; read the known mailboxes.

OTHER: TermAl's strict AcceptanceBindingEvidenceVerification lacks Engram's optional `bound` field (fix in TermAl w-540531f46f53 C4). No Engram flow binds verifications today. Flaky TermAl probe under load: w-31fe. Reviewer briefs start with "read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md". The watchdog cron lives only in the session (it survived the 10-19 reboot). After an OS crash, SQLite can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0; TermAl w-35bdcb766b6c).
